title: Replicating 'probes beat judges' for toxicity on a different model and benchmark

original_idea.body: Train a linear toxicity probe on one open model and evaluate detection AUROC on a benchmark not used for fitting, comparing against an LLM-as-judge baseline (cross-benchmark generalization).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: generalizable probes are useful monitoring infra, but link to catastrophic AI risk has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Linear probe + judge baseline on public benchmarks; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable; near-duplicate of gen-1374's intent.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Robustness replication labs underinvest in, open models/data.

novelty.reasoning: Probe-beats-judge replication on new benchmark; partly addressed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Close to existing work but cross-benchmark may be partly open.
